expressions: /* On a layer change, set the layer colour (W R O Y G B I V for layers 0-7). Register 30 = last layer_state. */ eol layer_state 30000 recall eq /* unchanged? */ eol 32000 recall /* then keep the current colour */ eol layer_state 0x01 eq 0x20FFFFFF mul /* layer 0: white */ eol layer_state 0x02 eq 0x20FF0000 mul add /* layer 1: red */ eol layer_state 0x04 eq 0x20FF7F00 mul add /* layer 2: orange */ eol layer_state 0x08 eq 0x20FFFF00 mul add /* layer 3: yellow */ eol layer_state 0x10 eq 0x2000FF00 mul add /* layer 4: green */ eol layer_state 0x20 eq 0x200000FF mul add /* layer 5: blue */ eol layer_state 0x40 eq 0x204B0082 mul add /* layer 6: indigo */ eol layer_state 0x80 eq 0x208B00FF mul add /* layer 7: violet */ eol ifte 32000 store eol layer_state 30000 store eol /* Keys Q W E R T Y U set the LED to red orange yellow green blue indigo violet (any layer) */ eol 0x00070014 input_state_binary 0x20FF0000 eol 0x0007001a input_state_binary 0x20FF7F00 eol 0x00070008 input_state_binary 0x20FFFF00 eol 0x00070015 input_state_binary 0x2000FF00 eol 0x00070017 input_state_binary 0x200000FF eol 0x0007001c input_state_binary 0x204B0082 eol 0x00070018 input_state_binary 0x208B00FF eol 32000 recall eol ifte ifte ifte ifte ifte ifte ifte eol 32000 store eol /* Keys A S D F G H J set the LED to red orange yellow green blue indigo violet at full intensity (any layer) */ eol 0x00070004 input_state_binary 0xFFFF0000 eol 0x00070016 input_state_binary 0xFFFF7F00 eol 0x00070007 input_state_binary 0xFFFFFF00 eol 0x00070009 input_state_binary 0xFF00FF00 eol 0x0007000a input_state_binary 0xFF0000FF eol 0x0007000b input_state_binary 0xFF4B0082 eol 0x0007000d input_state_binary 0xFF8B00FF eol 32000 recall eol ifte ifte ifte ifte ifte ifte ifte eol 32000 store

/* ===== ANIMATION KEYS Z X C V B (any layer): a key starts its animation, the same key again stops it, another key switches.
Registers: 29 = running animation (0 none, 1-5), 21 = new value, 28 = colour saved at start, 25 = start time, 23 = elapsed ===== */ eol /* Z = 1 */ 0x0007001d input_state_binary 0x0007001d prev_input_state_binary not mul 29000 recall 1000 eq 0 1000 ifte /* X = 2 */ 0x0007001b input_state_binary 0x0007001b prev_input_state_binary not mul 29000 recall 2000 eq 0 2000 ifte /* C = 3 */ 0x00070006 input_state_binary 0x00070006 prev_input_state_binary not mul 29000 recall 3000 eq 0 3000 ifte /* V = 4 */ 0x00070019 input_state_binary 0x00070019 prev_input_state_binary not mul 29000 recall 4000 eq 0 4000 ifte /* B = 5 */ 0x00070005 input_state_binary 0x00070005 prev_input_state_binary not mul 29000 recall 5000 eq 0 5000 ifte 29000 recall ifte ifte ifte ifte ifte 21000 store eol /* starting: save the colour */ 29000 recall not 21000 recall not not mul 32000 recall 28000 recall ifte 28000 store eol /* stopping: restore it */ 29000 recall not not 21000 recall not mul 28000 recall 32000 recall ifte 32000 store eol /* new animation: restart its timer */ 21000 recall 29000 recall eq not 21000 recall not not mul time_sec 25000 recall ifte 25000 store eol /* commit state, elapsed time */ 21000 recall 29000 store time_sec 25000 recall sub 23000 store

/* ===== ANIMATION RENDER: colour for the running animation (register 29) -> register 32 ===== */ eol /* 1 Z: red strobe 10 Hz */ 29000 recall 1000 eq 23000 recall 100 mod 50 lt 0x40FF0000 0 ifte eol /* 2 X: green blink 2 Hz, full intensity */ 29000 recall 2000 eq 23000 recall 500 mod 250 lt 0xFF00FF00 0 ifte eol /* 3 C: police red/blue 4 Hz */ 29000 recall 3000 eq 23000 recall 250 mod 125 lt 0xFFFF0000 0xFF0000FF ifte eol /* 4 V: blue breathing, 2 s per breath */ 29000 recall 4000 eq 23000 recall 2000 mod 180000 mul sin 1000 add 127000 mul 1000 add round 0x1000000 mul 0x000000FF add eol /* 5 B: rainbow, 1 cycle/s */ 29000 recall 5000 eq 23000 recall 1000 mod 360000 mul sin 1000 add 127500 mul round 0x10000 mul 23000 recall 1000 mod 360000 mul 120000 add sin 1000 add 127500 mul round 0x100 mul 23000 recall 1000 mod 360000 mul 240000 add sin 1000 add 127500 mul round 0x1 mul add add 0x60000000 add eol /* none running: keep the colour */ 32000 recall eol ifte ifte ifte ifte ifte 32000 store
